name: HPatches: Benchmark for Local Descriptors
description: HPatches (H-patches) is a benchmark for evaluating handcrafted and learned local feature descriptors under geometric and photometric changes. It comprises 116 planar scene sequences with precise ground-truth homographies, spanning 57 illumination-varying and 59 viewpoint-varying scenes with 6 images per sequence.
